page.layout: One column of text, with a marginal note on the right beside the paragraph "Purgant autē vel Bilem"; below the text, signature at left and catchword at right. Running head above the text, page number at top right.

main_text.p: melum, Calamintha, Centaurium majus, Chamaepitys, Hyoscyamus, Lybifti-cum, Lupulus, Peucedanum, Petroselinum, Rosmarinus, Ruta, Sisymbrium, Serpillum & Sampsuchus,&c.
Adhuc fuerunt folia manifesta qualitate alterantia. Sequuntur quae occulta: ut, Personata, Brassica, Hedera, Hyoscyamus, Ebulus, Trifolium, Aconitum, Pentaphyllum, &c.
Quae vero corrumpendo alterant, sunt: Aconitum, Cicuta, Hyoscyamus, Papaver corniculatum, Sardonia herba, Taxus, Thapsia, Toxicum, Pharicum[?], &c.
Purgant autē vel Bilem, vel Pituitam,Folia pur-gantia vel Aquam.
Flavam; Absinthium, Centaurium, Lupulus salictarius[?], Persici folia, &c.

page.notes: Right margin: the italic note "Folia pur-gantia" stands beside the paragraph "Purgant autē vel Bilem"; the printed mark after it is a small ornament, not transcribed. Doubtful readings: "salictarius" (the word is uncertain in the scan), and the dash-like mark after "Pharicum" is read as a stroke, not a letter. Long s is normalised to s throughout. Faint show-through text from the verso (at the right margin and in the middle of the page) is excluded. The hyphen in "Lybifti-cum" and "Petroseli-num" line-end breaks is printed; the word itself is written whole in "Petroselinum" as it continues on the next line.
